lines.zh: 石棺盖开了，我出来走走。
lines.en: The lid is off; I walk a while.

lines.zh: 墓窟的走廊只容我独行。
lines.en: These catacomb halls fit only me.

lines.zh: 每一步都震落末地石的灰。
lines.en: Every step shakes dust off the end stone.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在回廊里响两次。
lines.en: My steps echo twice down the corridor.

lines.zh: 沿着石砖巡逻，是旧习惯。
lines.en: Patrolling the flagstones is an old habit.
My plates clatter before I arrive.

lines.zh: 我拖着石尘走完整条墓道。
lines.en: I drag stone dust down the whole passage.
No wind down here, only footsteps.

lines.zh: 守卫不跑，只一步步逼近。
lines.en: A guard does not run; he closes in.
The coffin's chill travels with me.

lines.zh: 我绕墓窟一圈再回原位。
lines.en: I circle the crypt once, then return.
Slow, but never off the patrol line.
I stand still, a pillar of the crypt.

lines.zh: 呼吸？甲片里没有这东西。
lines.en: Breath? There is none inside this armor.
The silence of the crypt answers to me.

lines.zh: 不动时，我和石像没两样。
lines.en: Still, I pass for a statue.

lines.zh: 我静静数着滴水的声音。
lines.en: I count the slow dripping in the dark.

lines.zh: 我守这扇门，直到有人来。
lines.en: I keep this door until someone comes.
Dust settles on my shoulders; I let it.

lines.zh: 石棺还开着，我不急着回去。
lines.en: The coffin stays open; I am in no hurry.
End stone is cold, and so is my armor.
Standing, listening: footsteps far off.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，也没有眼可眨。
lines.en: I do not blink; I have no eyes to blink.

lines.zh: 守卫的职责，是一直在这里。
lines.en: A guard's duty is simply to remain.
You have stepped into the crypt, living one.
Put out that torch. No light here.
I know the smell of the living.
Your heartbeat wakes the whole passage.
Do not touch those sarcophagi.
Look at my armor, then think again.
Few of the living come this deep.

lines.zh: 你身后那扇门，是我关的。
lines.en: That door behind you? I closed it.
The End has no need of visitors.
Get your feet off those grave tiles.

lines.zh: 你的火把光，我一根根数着。
lines.en: I count your torchlight, one flame at a time.
You are breathing far too loudly.
More than stone is buried here.
One more step and I rise.
A seam splits in my armor.
It hurts, but the crypt does not retreat.
My dust is knocked loose.
Who is knocking on my bones?
Heavy enough. I will remember you.
Guards break too, only slower.
Grit falls from my shoulder.
I grunt once and keep standing.
A new wound over an old one.
Do not mistake a crack for a weakness.
Food? Nothing in a coffin needs feeding.

lines.zh: 你把面包举给我看，我无动于衷。
lines.en: You hold up bread; I do not care.
I forgot hunger long ago.
Put it away; the crypt has no table.
Gold? Treasure is not what I keep.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西换不来通行。
lines.en: What you hold buys you no passage.
I neither eat nor take offerings.
Keep your rations; the road is long.
I smelled incense once. It went out.
Do not test a tomb with food.
Hitting me is hitting a stone wall.
My plates caught you. Back off.
The hall is narrow; let me pass.
My shoulder is harder than end stone.
Do not press close unless you want hurt.
You were shoved back. Recover.
There is no walkway beside a coffin.
One touch and your bones go numb.
I do not shove. Standing is enough.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲在我身上刮出声。
lines.en: Your armor scrapes a noise on mine.
Nothing breeds in a crypt. Things are buried.
Guards do not pair off.
Sarcophagi do not come in pairs.

lines.zh: 这事我埋进墓砖深处了。
lines.en: I buried that question deep in the tiles.

lines.zh: 别问了，末地石听了会笑。
lines.en: Ask no more; the end stone would laugh.

lines.zh: 我的同类都是被埋出来的。
lines.en: My kind are made by burial, not birth.
Solitude is the guard's rule.

lines.zh: 这话题在墓道里不合时宜。
lines.en: Not a fitting topic for these halls.
I only keep watch. I do not spawn heirs.
Ask me something else, living one.

lines.zh: 地上那枚末影珍珠，我收下。
lines.en: That ender pearl on the floor is mine.
What falls belongs to the crypt.
I pick it up and set it by the coffin.
If you leave it, I keep it safe.

lines.zh: 金属在墓道里该被收起。
lines.en: Metal should be stored away down here.

lines.zh: 这骨头是上一位访客的。
lines.en: This bone belonged to the last visitor.
I bend slowly, but I do pick things up.

lines.zh: 散落物件让墓窟不整洁。
lines.en: Loose things make the crypt untidy.
Mine now. Keep your hands off.
I press it under a flagstone.
The footfalls match. It is you.
I lift my head and lock on a living thing.

lines.zh: 墓道里只剩你一个目标。
lines.en: Only one target is left in this hall.
My plates tighten. I am ready.
You touched a coffin. I remember.
Target confirmed. No more warnings.
I step out of the shadow.
The guard's duty begins now.
This blow is for the quiet I keep.
You cannot outrun a straight crypt hall.
I have your breathing pinned.

lines.zh: 猎杀在墓窟里不用预告。
lines.en: The hunt here needs no announcement.
One step, another, closing the gap.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里易断。
lines.en: I watch your knees. They break easily.
There is no retreat at the hall's end.
You can hear my plates, can you not?
I do not shout. I simply follow.
Stone dust closes in beside me.

lines.zh: 你在数我的脚步，我听着。
lines.en: You are counting my steps; I hear you.
Another step back and you hit a coffin.

lines.zh: 我的甲缝里还卡着旧骨屑。
lines.en: Old bone dust still sticks between my armor plates.
The distance shrinks. You should turn.

lines.zh: 这条回廊我走了几百年。
lines.en: I have walked this corridor for ages.

lines.zh: 墓砖下面，我的手一直在动。
lines.en: Under the tomb bricks, my hands keep moving.
It ends in a wall. You will stop.
My stone fist falls; the tiles crack.
This is the crypt's greeting.
My armored fist grazes your chest.
I was buried, and I have buried others.
This fist is heavier than end stone.

lines.zh: 挨一下，就懂守墓的重量。
lines.en: One hit and you learn a grave's weight.
I raise my arm and crush your shield.
Bone and stone come down together.
No combos. One blow is enough.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我的拳跟半步。
lines.en: You step back; my fist steps too.

lines.zh: 这一拳带着几百年的尘。
lines.en: This punch carries centuries of dust.
The floor opens a crack for you.
The coffin splits; I rise again.
Deep in the crypt, the lamp goes out.
I crawl out from beneath the end stone.
The guard is posted; the hall goes quiet.
Dust falls first, then me.

lines.zh: 有人在塔下挖得太深了。
lines.en: Someone dug too deep beneath the tower.
The clatter of assembling plates fills the hall.
I am posted to this level again.
The crypt door shuts on its own.
I stand. The coffin is empty.
Footsteps begin underground.
A fist pushes out of the stone seam.
This level is mine to keep.
Fire does not last long in a crypt.

lines.zh: 地面塌了，我摔进下一层。
lines.en: The floor gives way; I drop a level.
Brine seeps into my plates. Cold.

lines.zh: 炸药掀翻了我脚下的石砖。
lines.en: The blast throws the tiles from under me.
An arrow sticks in my plate like a thorn.

lines.zh: 咒语在我骨头上打了个转。
lines.en: A spell circles once around my bones.
Fast for ages and I only grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷打穿墓顶，落在我身上。
lines.en: Lightning pierces the vault and strikes me.

lines.zh: 末地的虚空在拽我的脚。
lines.en: The End's void tugs at my feet.
